skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply auditing theories to analyze and explain organizational and implementation issues in auditing and control.
Evaluate and propose on the organization and implementation of auditing and control in domestic and international units.
Use basic computer skills for research and practical application in data processing and report presentation.
Develop critical thinking skills to critique and criticize the application of auditing standards and methods.
Build communication skills to write reports and present specialized content in work.
Demonstrate independence in work, showing personal responsibility and responsibility to the team.
Identify and defend personal views based on an objective and scientific approach.
Identify and fulfill social responsibility and professional ethics when making judgments and evaluations on specialized issues.
